description: Send a message through a webhook using its ID and token (no bot permissions needed; the token authorizes the send). Supports per-message username/avatar overrides and up to 10 embeds. At least one of content or embeds is required. Returns the new message ID.

avatar_url.description: Override the webhook's default avatar for this message.

content.description: Plain-text body of the message (max 2000 characters). Optional if embeds are provided.

embeds.description: Up to 10 embed objects to attach to the webhook message.

author.description: Author block shown at the top of the embed.

icon_url.description: Small icon shown next to the author name.

url.description: URL the author name links to.

color.description: Side-bar color as a hex string, e.g. '#5865F2'.

description.description: Main body text of the embed (supports Markdown).

fields.description: Up to 25 name/value field blocks. Set inline:true on a field to render it side-by-side with adjacent inline fields (up to 3 per row).

inline.description: If true, render this field side-by-side with adjacent inline fields.

footer.description: Footer text shown at the bottom of the embed.

image_url.description: Large image shown below the embed body.

thumbnail_url.description: Small image shown in the top-right corner.

timestamp.description: If true, stamp the embed with the current time.

title.description: Embed title shown in bold at the top.

url.description: URL that makes the title clickable.

username.description: Override the webhook's default display name for this message.

webhook_id.description: ID (snowflake) of the webhook to send through.

webhook_token.description: Secret token of the webhook (from discord_create_webhook or discord_list_webhooks).

name: discord_send_webhook_message
